@I.ir_module
class Module:
    @T.prim_func
    def main(x_handle: T.handle, w_handle: T.handle, y_handle: T.handle):
        N_out = T.int32()
        x = T.match_buffer(x_handle, (N_out + 5 - 1,), "float16", strides=(1,))
        w = T.match_buffer(w_handle, (5,), "float16", strides=(1,))
        y = T.match_buffer(y_handle, (N_out,), "float16", strides=(1,))
        # with T.sblock("root"):
        for bx in T.thread_binding((N_out + 2048 - 1) // 2048, thread="blockIdx.x"):
            for tx in T.thread_binding(256, thread="threadIdx.x"):
                for ty in T.thread_binding(1, thread="threadIdx.y"):
                    for tz in T.thread_binding(1, thread="threadIdx.z"):
                        with T.sblock("tilelang_root"):
                            T.reads()
                            T.writes()
                            x_shared = T.sblock_alloc_buffer((2052,), "float16", scope="shared.dyn")
                            w_local = T.sblock_alloc_buffer((5,), scope="local")
                            r = T.sblock_alloc_buffer((12,), scope="local")
                            out = T.sblock_alloc_buffer((8,), "float16", scope="local")
                            base: T.int32 = bx * 2048 + tx * 8
                            if base + 8 <= N_out + 5 - 1:
                                for j in T.vectorized(8):
                                    x_shared[tx * 8 + j] = x[base + j]
                            else:
                                for j in range(8):
                                    x_shared[tx * 8 + j] = T.if_then_else(base + j < N_out + 5 - 1, x[base + j], T.float16(0.0))
                            if tx < 4:
                                x_shared[2048 + tx] = T.if_then_else(bx * 2048 + 2048 + tx < N_out + 5 - 1, x[bx * 2048 + 2048 + tx], T.float16(0.0))
                            for k in range(5):
                                w_local[k] = T.Cast("float32", w[k])
                            T.tvm_storage_sync("shared")
                            if base < N_out:
                                for j in range(12):
                                    r[j] = T.Cast("float32", x_shared[tx * 8 + j])
                                for j in range(8):
                                    out[j] = T.Cast("float16", w_local[0] * r[j] + w_local[1] * r[j + 1] + w_local[2] * r[j + 2] + w_local[3] * r[j + 3] + w_local[4] * r[j + 4])
                                if base + 8 <= N_out:
                                    for j in T.vectorized(8):
                                        y[base + j] = out[j]
                                else:
                                    for j in range(8):
                                        if base + j < N_out:
                                            y[base + j] = out[j]

class Module:
    @T.prim_func
    def main(x_handle: T.handle, w_handle: T.handle, y_handle: T.handle):
        N_out = T.int32()
        x = T.match_buffer(x_handle, (N_out + 5 - 1,), "float16", strides=(1,))
        w = T.match_buffer(w_handle, (5,), "float16", strides=(1,))
        y = T.match_buffer(y_handle, (N_out,), "float16", strides=(1,))
        # with T.sblock("root"):
        for bx in T.thread_binding((N_out + 2048 - 1) // 2048, thread="blockIdx.x"):
            for tx in T.thread_binding(256, thread="threadIdx.x"):
                for ty in T.thread_binding(1, thread="threadIdx.y"):
                    for tz in T.thread_binding(1, thread="threadIdx.z"):
                        with T.sblock("tilelang_root"):
                            T.reads()
                            T.writes()
                            x_shared = T.sblock_alloc_buffer((2052,), "float16", scope="shared.dyn")
                            w_local = T.sblock_alloc_buffer((5,), scope="local")
                            r = T.sblock_alloc_buffer((12,), scope="local")
                            out = T.sblock_alloc_buffer((8,), "float16", scope="local")
                            base: T.int32 = bx * 2048 + tx * 8
                            if base + 8 <= N_out + 5 - 1:
                                for j in T.vectorized(8):
                                    x_shared[tx * 8 + j] = x[base + j]
                            else:
                                for j in range(8):
                                    x_shared[tx * 8 + j] = T.if_then_else(base + j < N_out + 5 - 1, x[base + j], T.float16(0.0))
                            if tx < 4:
                                x_shared[2048 + tx] = T.if_then_else(bx * 2048 + 2048 + tx < N_out + 5 - 1, x[bx * 2048 + 2048 + tx], T.float16(0.0))
                            for k in range(5):
                                w_local[k] = T.Cast("float32", w[k])
                            T.tvm_storage_sync("shared")
                            if base < N_out:
                                for j in range(12):
                                    r[j] = T.Cast("float32", x_shared[tx * 8 + j])
                                for j in range(8):
                                    out[j] = T.Cast("float16", w_local[0] * r[j] + w_local[1] * r[j + 1] + w_local[2] * r[j + 2] + w_local[3] * r[j + 3] + w_local[4] * r[j + 4])
                                if base + 8 <= N_out:
                                    for j in T.vectorized(8):
                                        y[base + j] = out[j]
                                else:
                                    for j in range(8):
                                        if base + j < N_out:
                                            y[base + j] = out[j]

@I.ir_module
class Module:
    @T.prim_func
    def main(x_handle: T.handle, w_handle: T.handle, y_handle: T.handle):
        T.func_attr({"target": T.target({"arch": "sm_90a", "host": {"keys": ["cpu"], "kind": "c", "tag": ""}, "keys": ["cuda", "gpu"], "kind": "cuda", "max_num_threads": 1024, "tag": "", "thread_warp_size": 32})})
        N_out = T.int32()
        x = T.match_buffer(x_handle, (N_out + 5 - 1,), "float16", strides=(1,))
        w = T.match_buffer(w_handle, (5,), "float16", strides=(1,))
        y = T.match_buffer(y_handle, (N_out,), "float16", strides=(1,))
        # with T.sblock("root"):
        T.attr(0 < N_out, "tl.assume", "Buffer shape should be greater than 0: shape `N_out` from buffer `y`")
        T.attr(T.bool(True), "tl.assume", "Buffer shape should be greater than 0: shape `N_out + 5 - 1` from buffer `x`")
        bx = T.launch_thread("blockIdx.x", (N_out + 2047) // 2048)
        tx = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.x", 256)
        ty = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.y", 1)
        tz = T.launch_thread("threadIdx.z", 1)
        with T.sblock("tilelang_root"):
            T.reads()
            T.writes()
            x_shared = T.sblock_alloc_buffer((2052,), "float16", scope="shared.dyn")
            w_local = T.sblock_alloc_buffer((5,), scope="local")
            r = T.sblock_alloc_buffer((12,), scope="local")
            out = T.sblock_alloc_buffer((8,), "float16", scope="local")
            if bx * 2048 + tx * 8 + 4 <= N_out:
                for j in T.vectorized(8):
                    x_shared[tx * 8 + j] = x[bx * 2048 + tx * 8 + j]
            else:
                for j in range(8):
                    x_shared[tx * 8 + j] = T.if_then_else(bx * 2048 + tx * 8 + j < N_out + 4, x[bx * 2048 + tx * 8 + j], T.float16(0.0))
            if tx < 4:
                x_shared[tx + 2048] = T.if_then_else(bx * 2048 + tx + 2044 < N_out, x[bx * 2048 + tx + 2048], T.float16(0.0))
            for k in range(5):
                w_local[k] = T.Cast("float32", w[k])
            T.tvm_storage_sync("shared")
            if bx * 2048 + tx * 8 < N_out:
                for j in range(12):
                    r[j] = T.Cast("float32", x_shared[tx * 8 + j])
            if bx * 2048 + tx * 8 < N_out:
                for j in range(8):
                    out[j] = T.Cast("float16", w_local[0] * r[j] + w_local[1] * r[j + 1] + w_local[2] * r[j + 2] + w_local[3] * r[j + 3] + w_local[4] * r[j + 4])
            if bx * 2048 + tx * 8 < N_out:
                if bx * 2048 + tx * 8 + 8 <= N_out:
                    for j in T.vectorized(8):
                        y[bx * 2048 + tx * 8 + j] = out[j]
                else:
                    for j in range(8):
                        if bx * 2048 + tx * 8 + j < N_out:
                            y[bx * 2048 + tx * 8 + j] = out[j]
